mentions.name: picosnitch
mentions.description: This per-executable network monitor for Linux tracks network activity by executable, featuring a rewritten UI and a core ported from BCC to BPF CO-RE. Its completeness and accuracy were benchmarked with AI-designed tests, and published results identify a gap to fix in the next release.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also recently resumed working on picosnitch, a per executable network monitor for Linux. I rewrote the UI, ported the core from BCC to BPF CO-RE, and used AI to benchmark the completeness and accuracy of it.
